# bgev

An R package for the bimodal GEV (Generalized Extreme Value)
distribution: density, distribution, quantile, and random generation
functions, plus maximum likelihood estimation. Useful for modeling
heterogeneous bimodal data, as described in Otiniano et al. (2023)
<doi:10.1007/s10651-023-00566-7>.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("thiagodoregosousa/bgev")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(bgev)

set.seed(1)
x <- rbgev(n = 1000, mu = 0, sigma = 1, xi = 0.5, delta = 1)

hist(x, probability = TRUE, breaks = 30)
lines(sort(x), dbgev(sort(x), mu = 0, sigma = 1, xi = 0.5, delta = 1), col = "red")

fit <- bgev_mle(x)
fit$optim$bestmem
```

## Functions

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`dbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md) | Density of the bimodal GEV distribution |
| [`pbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md) | Distribution function |
| [`qbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md) | Quantile function |
| [`rbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md) | Random generation |
| [`bgev_mle()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_mle.md) | Maximum likelihood estimation of the four parameters |
| [`bgev_log_likelihood()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_log_likelihood.md) | Log-likelihood used by [`bgev_mle()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_mle.md) |
| [`bgev_valid_params()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_valid_params.md) | Check whether a set of parameters is valid |
| [`bgev_support()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_support.md) | Compute the support of the distribution for given parameters |

See the
[Reference](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/index.html)
page for full documentation.

## Package layout

- `R/` — package source: distribution functions
  (`R/bgev_distribution.R`), support/validity (`R/bgev_domain.R`), MLE
  (`R/bgev_estimation.R`), and starting-value heuristics
  (`R/bgev_start_params.R`)
- `man/`, `NAMESPACE` — generated by `devtools::document()`; do not edit
  by hand
- `tests/testthat/` — unit tests, run via `devtools::test()`
- `benchmarks/` — Monte Carlo studies and dev/exploratory scripts, not
  part of the installed package
- `inst/shiny-app/` — interactive density explorer, run with
  `shiny::runApp(system.file("shiny-app", package = "bgev"))`
- `to_be_implemented/` — planned features not yet implemented

## Reference

Otiniano, Cira E. G., et al. (2023). *A bimodal model for extremes
data*. Environmental and Ecological Statistics.
<doi:10.1007/s10651-023-00566-7>

# Package index

## Distribution

Density, distribution, quantile, and random generation for the bimodal
GEV.

- [`dbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md)
  [`pbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md)
  [`qbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md)
  [`rbgev()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev.md)
  : Bimodal GEV (generalized extreme value) distribution

## Estimation

Maximum likelihood fitting and the underlying log-likelihood.

- [`bgev_mle()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_mle.md)
  : Maximum Likelihood Estimation for the BGEV distribution
- [`bgev_log_likelihood()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_log_likelihood.md)
  : Log-likelihood function for the BGEV distribution
- [`bgev_start_using_quantiles()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_start_using_quantiles.md)
  : Starting values for BGEV distribution

## Support & validity

Parameter checks and support of the distribution.

- [`bgev_valid_params()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_valid_params.md)
  : Validate BGEV parameters
- [`bgev_support()`](https://thiagodoregosousa.github.io/bgev/reference/bgev_support.md)
  : Compute the support of the BGEV distribution
